name: Morzine
description: Morzine is the most charming base village on the French side of Portes du Soleil. Traditional wooden chalets, a lively central square, genuine Haute-Savoie culture and traditions. Linked to Avoriaz via a cable car from its centre, giving access to the full 600km Portes du Soleil. Excellent year-round destination with mountain biking in summer. Balanced apres — lively but not wild. A real village, not a purpose-built resort.

overview.atmosphere: Authentic Haute-Savoie village, charming chalet architecture, lively and traditional. The heart of the French side of Portes du Soleil.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Indoor climbing, ice skating, cinema, bowling, Montriond Lake (summer swimming), farm visits, mini golf

honest_drawbacks: Valley floor altitude (1,000m) — snow variable at base
Busy in peak weeks — crowded village streets
Cable car queue to Avoriaz can be long
